newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca sales in line with expectations.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca sales in line with expectations.

text.p: Zeneca's 14 percent sales growth in the first nine months of the year was in line with analysts' expectations
But industry watchers said it was impossible to say what impact the figures would have on the drug company's shares, pointing at persistent takeover rumours focusing on Zeneca.

"It's hard to say how the shares will react. Let's put it this way: nobody will be disappointed because of these figures," said one analyst. "It is encouraging to see such strong sales growth, but as to what it will do to fundamentals: they don't really count very much," said Paul Laing at SocGen.
Zeneca said total sales rose to 4.1 billion stg from 3.7 billion, driven by the launch of new products.
"The figures show a very, very slight slowdown on the first-half figures," an analyst said.

"But that's not all together surprising since we had expected pharmaceuticals to slow slightly because of de-stocking and because we knew from Ciba's results last week that the third quarter comparison in agrochemicals would be tougher than in the first-half comparison," he added.
Zeneca fell 8-1/2 pence to 1741-1/2 in a generally weak pre-market. The shares had gained 11 pence on Monday.
